card.name: Citation and published-literature cues
card.fires_on: Words at the point where a reference is given or expected: 'literature' or 'data' after 'published', 'al' in 'et al.', years inside author-year citations, and 'Citation:' labels.

modes.label: Published literature wording
modes.description: A noun such as literature, data or sources that refers to published work.
modes.example: published<< literature>> and an individual patient concentration using current assays

modes.label: Author-year citations
modes.description: Parts of an in-text citation, such as the year digits, 'al', or the opening bracket before a year.
modes.example: Sante et al., 1993; Peterson et<< al>>., 2001; Te

card.writes: It suppresses citation words such as cited, refs, literature and papers, so it seems to damp further citation words right after a reference cue.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is pointing to published studies or giving a reference.
